parameters.jsCode:
const prompt = 'You plan a daily educational YouTube channel. Today's niche is: ' + $json.niche + ' (' + $json.brief + ').
Candidate trending items:
Wikipedia most read: ' + JSON.stringify($json.wikiList) + '
Tech news headlines: ' + JSON.stringify($json.hnList) + '
Google Trends: ' + JSON.stringify($json.gtList) + '

Choose exactly 6 DIFFERENT topics that fit the niche, are factual and safe for a general audience, and each has an English Wikipedia article. Prefer trending items when they fit; otherwise choose evergreen topics of high interest. Avoid: politics, elections, war, violence, crime, tragedies, deaths, celebrity gossip, medical advice, adult content, living private people. ' + ($json.kids ? 'This is for children aged 6 to 12. Choose ONLY from this evergreen list of kid-friendly topics: ' + JSON.stringify($json.kidsPool) + '. Never choose anything else. ' : '') + 'Return JSON only: {"topics":[{"wikipedia_title":"exact English Wikipedia article title","angle":"one sentence on the most interesting angle","format":"wide"|"short"}]} with 3 wide and 3 short.';
return {json: {body: {contents: [{parts: [{text: prompt}]}], generationConfig: {responseMimeType: 'application/json', temperature: 0.5}}}};
